dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: The furtive shades of our destinies intertwine themselves beneath hallowed light. Should tenebrous forces obscure thine path, you may call out my name in humble supplication.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein says, "Good morning, the sun is quite fine today. If you encounter any difficulties, please call for me."
